integrity: The all-n proof is a direct conditional-exchangeability calculation. The packaged checker exhaustively enumerates permutations through n=9 for the ordinary and several weighted cases; those finite checks supplement rather than replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a uniform random permutation.
It gives conditional first moments and covariance, not conditional distributions or independence.
A recent paper conditions on the total number of fixed points and is close in subject matter; an older equivalent local identity remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact local fixed-point covariance law for weighted inversions
